verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Datadog's Agent/LLM Observability Experiments feature, which uses versioned datasets and result comparison to show how prompt or model changes affect performance. That is an offline experimentation framework, not an interactive prompt playground. Nothing in the pack shows a playground for iterating on prompts against real models with templated variables, so this adjacent feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: It helps you understand how changes to prompts, models, providers, or system architecture affect performance.
